summary_zh: 泰國今日焦點：商務部與10個鋼鐵協會研議反傾銷措施，8個月鋼材進口達798,584噸；工業聯合會與14家車廠推動新消費稅制以提高本地含量，製造商貿易合規與供應鏈在地化壓力上升。同時NetSuite以Agentic AI縮短ERP導入時間，Fuji測試大型晶片自動化SMT組裝，反映數位化與產線自動化需求。
summary_en: Thailand weighs anti-dumping steps after 798,584 tonnes of steel imports in 8 months, while FTI and 14 carmakers push a new excise scheme to raise local content. NetSuite claims AI cuts ERP go-live to weeks, and Fuji tests automated SMT for 1.3 kg chips, signaling compliance and automation needs.
